segments.speaker: spk1
segments.text: STUFF IT INTO YOU HIS BELLY COUNSELLED HIM

segments.speaker: spk2
segments.text: BUT IN THIS VIGNETTE COPIED FROM TURNER YOU HAVE THE TWO PRINCIPLES BROUGHT OUT PERFECTLY

segments.speaker: spk1
segments.text: HARANGUE THE TIRESOME PRODUCT OF A TIRELESS TONGUE

segments.speaker: spk2
segments.text: YET THESE THOUGHTS AFFECTED HESTER PRYNNE LESS WITH HOPE THAN APPREHENSION

segments.speaker: spk1
segments.text: HIS HAT HAD A PEAKED CROWN AND A FLAT BRIM AND AROUND THE BRIM WAS A ROW OF TINY GOLDEN BELLS THAT TINKLED WHEN HE MOVED

segments.speaker: spk2
segments.text: AFTER PROCEEDING A FEW MILES THE PROGRESS OF HAWKEYE WHO LED THE ADVANCE BECAME MORE DELIBERATE AND WATCHFUL
